messages.subject: Re: API Documentation
messages.body_plain:
I think we'll try to get that published automatically with each build and linked to readthedocs, but in the meantime if you've got the source downloaded, you can generate them with

mvn javadoc:aggregator

HTH,
Alex

messages.body_plain:
Good day, colleagues.

I try to find information about source location of function symbol in context.  (without this, debugging is quite hard).

  I guess that symbol attribute must be set in parser, but see that in attachSrcRef  in   src/main/java/org/renjin/parser/RParser.java  this code is commented out.  Are exists some story behind this, or it's not yet implemented or exists some reason do not store line numbers ?
